shortDescription: South Koreans should not worry too much about short-term volatility in the won because structural changes have made the currency more resilient than in the past, former Bank of Korea Governor Rhee Chang Yong said, according to Bloomberg.

title: Former Bank of Korea Governor Says Won’s Short-Term Swings Need Not Alarm South Koreans
